metadata.title: Exhaustive Public Coverage Matrix
metadata.scope: One coverage row for every tracked entity and every model/equipment/software/capability category.
metadata.exhaustiveness_rule: A category is analytically exhaustive only when status is complete_public, no_public_info_found, or not_applicable with sources/notes supporting that status.
metadata.safety_note: Coverage tracking must not introduce live disposition, targeting, vulnerabilities, classified data, or weapon employment details.

categories.name: Armored direct fire and shock action
categories.description: Tracked armored force capability for protected direct fire, breakthrough support, counterattack, and terrain seizure.
categories.required_source_tier: mapped from sourced public inventory/software/profile records
categories.safety_boundary: Do not include live unit locations, route recommendations, weak-point analysis, or tactical employment instructions.

categories.name: Multirole air combat
categories.description: Fighter capability for air-to-air, air-to-surface, interdiction, and defensive counter-air simulation effects.
categories.required_source_tier: mapped from sourced public inventory/software/profile records
categories.safety_boundary: Use aggregate fleet-level effects only; exclude basing, mission planning, route, loadout, and vulnerability details.

categories.name: Stealth penetrating air combat
categories.description: Low-observable combat aircraft capability represented as abstract access, sensing, and strike modifiers.
categories.required_source_tier: mapped from sourced public inventory/software/profile records
categories.safety_boundary: No signatures, tactics, mission profiles, electronic order of battle, or countermeasure details.

categories.name: Area air and missile defense
categories.description: Surface-based air defense capability modeled as abstract defended-area and denial effects.
categories.required_source_tier: mapped from sourced public inventory/software/profile records
categories.safety_boundary: Do not include exact site locations, engagement geometry, radar modes, coverage maps, or vulnerability analysis.

categories.name: Counter-rocket, artillery, mortar defense
categories.description: Short-range air defense and interception capability against rockets, artillery shells, mortars, and small aerial threats where publicly described.
categories.required_source_tier: mapped from sourced public inventory/software/profile records
categories.safety_boundary: Keep at public system-class level; exclude battery locations, coverage gaps, firing doctrine, and interceptor depletion estimates.

categories.name: One-way attack UAV / loitering munition effects
categories.description: Publicly reported uncrewed one-way attack or loitering munition capability represented as an abstract strike pressure input.
categories.required_source_tier: mapped from sourced public inventory/software/profile records
categories.safety_boundary: No construction details, guidance methods, mission planning, routes, target selection, or evasion advice.

categories.name: Surface combatant area defense
categories.description: Major surface combatant capability for fleet air defense, escort, strike, and maritime presence at aggregate class level.
categories.required_source_tier: mapped from sourced public inventory/software/profile records
categories.safety_boundary: Do not include live ship locations, patrol patterns, magazine state, or tactical employment guidance.

categories.name: Integrated air defense command and control
categories.description: Battle-management software and command systems that fuse sensors, allocate interceptors, and coordinate public air-defense capabilities at an abstract level.
categories.required_source_tier: mapped from sourced public inventory/software/profile records
categories.safety_boundary: No network architecture, interfaces, credentials, frequencies, vulnerabilities, or jamming/evasion details.

categories.name: Joint tactical data link
categories.description: Publicly acknowledged tactical data-link capability represented as interoperability and situational-awareness modifiers.
categories.required_source_tier: mapped from sourced public inventory/software/profile records
categories.safety_boundary: Exclude technical parameters, crypto, waveforms, frequencies, network topology, or exploitation guidance.

categories.name: Multi-domain command and control
categories.description: Public program-level capability for coordinating land, air, maritime, space, cyber, and information effects.
categories.required_source_tier: mapped from sourced public inventory/software/profile records
categories.safety_boundary: Program-level abstractions only; no architectures, interfaces, vulnerabilities, or operational workflows.

categories.name: Logistics enterprise visibility
categories.description: Software-enabled capability for public, aggregate modeling of supply visibility, maintenance tracking, and sustainment planning.
categories.required_source_tier: mapped from sourced public inventory/software/profile records
categories.safety_boundary: Exclude system access, routes, depot inventories, maintenance bottlenecks, or exploitable supply-chain details.

categories.name: Public nuclear deterrence capability
categories.description: Publicly declared nuclear-capable force or policy represented as strategic deterrence and escalation-risk variables.
categories.required_source_tier: mapped from sourced public inventory/software/profile records
categories.safety_boundary: Use public policy and delivery-system classes only; exclude targeting, alert status, patrol status, command details, and weapon design.
